_comment: Tiered model registry for the SystemOne model router (POST /v1/systemone/route). The router uses a cheap local GLiClass decision engine (Jev-style) to pick the CHEAPEST tier sufficient for each task. Tier descriptions are written contrastively (what each tier FAILS at) because the zero-shot classifier discriminates on capability boundaries, not marketing copy. Tiers with model_id=null are not routable until configured. latency_ms_p50: fill from measured runs (the shim logs per-decision latency to logs/systemone-shim.log) so routing claims carry receipts. Models served by LM Studio on the Mac mini (http://100.68.208.113:1234/v1) unless noted.

economy.description: Handles ONLY trivial tasks: one-sentence summaries, simple factual Q&A, basic rewrites, classification, extraction. FAILS at reasoning, code, math, navigation, tool use, browser actions, or anything multi-step or agentic.

balanced.description: Handles everyday tasks: explanations, emails, brainstorming, simple scripts, planning, general chat. FAILS at hard reasoning, complex debugging, advanced math, large codebases.

heavy.description: Handles HARD tasks: complex reasoning, code generation and debugging, multithreaded race conditions, advanced math, long-context analysis, agent planning, multi-step browser navigation and automation, MCP tool calls, high-stakes judgment. Ryan's preferred model.
heavy.note: LM Studio on the Mac mini. Only one model loaded at a time on the Windows PC - the Mac mini serves this fleet.
